.@TVFanatic commends Hudson Williams’ performance as Henry Park in this week’s ’YAGA’ episode! 

“This is our first real look at Hudson Williams as Henry Park, and he’s fully ensconced in the diabolic energy of the Park heir. He’s on screen for only a few moments, and I can practically smell the evil wafting off that pristine white sweater. I love it when you’re familiar with an actor in a specific role, only to see them step into a character who’s the complete opposite of what you’re accustomed to seeing them play and lose themselves in it so fully that it’s like you’re seeing them for the first time.

We’re getting the idea that Henry is awful, but if Hudson doesn’t infuse Henry with that smugness, dripping with self-satisfaction, we don’t get the full picture when he appears on-screen. In the few seconds we see him, he gives Henry an air of utter entitlement and disdain that makes you hate him viscerally. Kudos to the series, too, for how it edits the scene, complete with a kiss between Henry and Logan.”
